\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows,positioning}

% Source-derived from the legacy angle 60 declaration.
\makeatletter
\pgfarrowsdeclare{polar transition}{polar transition}
{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.3pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.25\pgflinewidth
  \pgfutil@tempdimb=7.29\pgfutil@tempdima
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdimb by.5\pgflinewidth
  \pgfarrowsleftextend{-\pgfutil@tempdimb}
  \pgfutil@tempdimb=.5\pgfutil@tempdima
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdimb by\pgflinewidth
  \pgfarrowsrightextend{\pgfutil@tempdimb}
}
{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.3pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.25\pgflinewidth
  \pgfsetroundcap
  \pgfsetmiterjoin
  \pgfpathmoveto{\pgfpointadd{\pgfqpoint{.5\pgfutil@tempdima}{0pt}}{\pgfqpointpolar{150}{9\pgfutil@tempdima}}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{.5\pgfutil@tempdima}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfpointadd{\pgfqpoint{.5\pgfutil@tempdima}{0pt}}{\pgfqpointpolar{-150}{9\pgfutil@tempdima}}}
  \pgfusepathqstroke
}
\makeatother

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  node distance=13mm and 19mm,
  task/.style={draw,rounded corners=2pt,minimum width=22mm,minimum height=8mm,align=center}
]
  \node[task,fill=blue!8] (input) {Input};
  \node[task,fill=yellow!14,right=of input] (check) {Check};
  \node[task,fill=green!10,right=of check] (done) {Done};
  \node[task,fill=red!8,below=of check] (retry) {Retry};

  \draw[blue,line width=.4pt,-{polar transition}] (input) -- node[above]{parse} (check);
  \draw[green!50!black,line width=1pt,-{polar transition}] (check) -- node[above]{accept} (done);
  \draw[red,line width=1.6pt,-{polar transition}] (check) -- node[right]{reject} (retry);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
